materiality_threshold: max($0.05, min(2% x basis, $25)); flag on >= (D16).
note: Every rule the key generator applied, published so the agent can compete against rules it can read (D35). Not claimed as industry norm.
payable_quantity: min(qty_ordered, qty_received); received is summed across all goods receipts for a line (D15, D31).
precision: Every flagging comparison is made at full Decimal precision with no rounding beforehand, and is division-free — the tax test is cross-multiplied. An agent that rounds before comparing, or divides to derive a rate, may disagree at a threshold boundary even with identical inputs (D23, D28).
price_variance: (inv_unit_price - po_unit_price) x payable_qty; basis = payable_qty x po_unit_price (D16, D19).
quantity_overbill: invoiced > payable; value = (invoiced - payable) x po_unit_price; same materiality; category by which constraint bound the payable quantity (D15, D16).
tax_variance: document-scoped; expected tax = PO-derived rate x invoice's own taxable subtotal; evaluated cross-multiplied, no division; zero taxable subtotal takes the degenerate $0.05 branch (D21, D24, D28, D29).
